|strategy=By [mailto:jralrea@ilstu.edu Joe Alread]<ref name="decipher-strategy">https://web.archive.org/web/20040811123219/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/endor/light/small/insurrection.html</ref>

The "surprise beatdown" tactic of Nabrun and Elis has finally come to an end with [[Insurrection]]. No more jumping around during a control phase and draining either, that's over with! Not only that, but giving your unique Rebels of ability &lt; 3 forfeit +2 is extremely helpful for thos emidrange characters with some funky gametetxts. Wedge with a forfeit of 8? Insane! Biggs with a forfeit of 7? Crazy! And finally, the last use on this card helps provide even more moving ability

[[Cloud City: Platform 327 (Docking Bay){{!}}Docking Bay]] many planets are yours to visit! Additionally, this final function allows you to keep an eye on important cards you are trying to track in your Reserve.
|rulings=* Read this as owner's move phase and ''any'' exterior sites (not as owner's move phase and ''owner's'' exterior sites).<ref name="scomp">https://scomp.starwarsccg.org/?s=Insurrection</ref>
